entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: When I took you in, I thought I was the[n]one helping you... but it turns out it was[n]the other way around.
I'm free from my attic prison.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Stop it. I'd rather hear that coming from[n]a lady.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well that's a cold thing to say.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, and sorry... I wanted to have Futaba[n]see you off too...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I haven't been able to find her since this[n]morning though.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If you end up back in the city, come on by.[n]I'll at least treat you to a nice cup of coffee.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Wait, that means I can't go closing the[n]store, huh...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What're you doing? Hurry up and go.
